null_dense_normal.sampling: entries ~ N(0,1), rows scaled to unit L1 norm, signs free

null_matched_support_and_sign.sampling: designed zero pattern and signs held fixed, magnitudes ~ |N(0,1)|, rows scaled to unit L1 norm

notes.scope: all O*NET occupations rated on both Work Values and Interests; no participant data of any kind
notes.auc: probability that a curated related pair is closer than a randomly drawn pair; 0.5 is chance, but chance is not the informative baseline
notes.baselines: raw_work_values is the input the projection consumes, so it bounds what the projection could preserve; random_projection_null holds the representation type fixed and varies only the matrix
notes.criterion: O*NET relatedness is built largely from shared skills, knowledge, and activities rather than shared work values, which bears on the RIASEC comparison but not on raw-versus-projected, where both sides are the same construct
